That works and it's clear. Clicking the little clock on the card marked it — the button changed to show it's on, I got an "Added to Read later" message so I knew it took, and the "Read later" count in the sidebar ticked up. So between the card changing, the confirmation, and the count, there's no doubt the link got flagged.

And the placement feels right. Being able to flag something for later with a single click straight from the card is exactly the low-effort thing I'd want — I don't want to open anything up just to say "come back to this." And having a "Read later" spot in the sidebar means I can go straight to just those when I've got time to actually read. That's the "read this later, then come back to just those" flow I asked for early on. Good.
